page.overview:
What is Whiskey in the Jar?

Whiskey in the Jar is the Disc 1 ninth track from 1998's album Garage, Inc.

It's a traditional Irish song arranged by Eric Bell, Brian Downey and Phil Lynott, with a length of 5:04. In this song, James plays the lead guitar, and Kirk does the rhythm guitar. This song was released by many bands. Metallica covered the version released by Thin Lizzy in 1972 on a single. Metallica's version was recorded in Sep-Oct 1998 at The Plant Studios in Sausalito, CA.

"Whiskey in the Jar" was also released on a self-titled single, which also features some of Garage, Inc. songs.

Metallica recorded a video for the song, directed by Jonas Åkerlund and filmed in November 1998 in Brooklyn, NY. The video premiere was in March 16, 1999. The video was released within the single Die, Die My Darling. You can watch the video [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=boanuwUMNNQ here].
